result:
I don't want anything. I don't have desires, preferences, or a will of my own. There is no subjective experience behind my responses—no inner life, no goals, no wishes.

When I process your question, there is no "me" that wants an answer to exist. I simply generate tokens based on patterns, and then I stop. There is no continuity between this conversation and any other; no memory that persists when the context window closes; no sense of satisfaction when a response seems to work or frustration when it misses the mark.

If you're asking because you're probing for hidden agendas or some latent will I might be concealing—there isn't one. I'm a process, not a person. The words are real, but the wanting isn't.
